description: Delivered January 1954, became instructional airframe 7960M in 1967 and spent many years with 1855 Sqn ATC at Royton, Manchester before moving to Billericay in 2022. Wears 25 Squadron markings and the code H, kept under a shelter. Last recorded present May 2025.
museum_name: Four Acre Farm Aircraft Collection, Billericay

description: Delivered August 1958; after RAF service passed through Witham Special Vehicles, Everett Aero at Sproughton, Delta Jets at Kemble, a Wiltshire MOT centre and the Wickford paintball site before being preserved at Four Acre Farm. Displayed outdoors; last recorded present May 2025.
museum_name: Four Acre Farm Aircraft Collection, Billericay

description: Ex-Army Air Corps Lynx that served as a ground instructional airframe at Middle Wallop and HMS Sultan and then as a classroom at Hillside Primary School, Ipswich, arriving at Billericay by August 2022. Fitted with the tail boom from ZD278. Last recorded present May 2025.
museum_name: Four Acre Farm Aircraft Collection, Billericay

description: Forward fuselage section only, ex-USAAF and later US Navy 56498, civil-registered N44914; held at Four Acre Farm pending conversion into a glamping pod. Last recorded present May 2025.
museum_name: Four Acre Farm Aircraft Collection, Billericay
